frames.narration: Here we go, folks. This is the briefing for Period eleven, week four, District ten. Your supervisor is out this week and I am covering, so for the next five days your questions, your issues, and your surprises come to me. Fifteen and a quarter hours across seventeen sets. Snack Nuts and Packaged Bulk are the real work, fuel comes with one rule that is not up for discussion, and Specialty Bath includes a small scavenger hunt. Your Monday call and your daily routine stay exactly as they are. Checkpoints along the way, and they count.

blocks.html: Not every store has every set. Store lists are on each stop. Your sign-off sheet is the final list.

frames.narration: Here is the week on one screen. Grocery carries seven sets, Health Beauty Care carries five, and Deli, Cosmetics, Natural Foods, and Fuel fill in the rest. Snack Nuts is the big one at four hours, then Natural Foods Packaged Bulk at two and Fuel at two. Fuel counts once: your store has a kiosk or a walk-in, and you set the one you have. Nine of the seventeen are quarter-hour maintenances. Two sets run cold, Butter and Specialty Cheese, and cold product stays out of the case no longer than twenty minutes. Not every store carries every set. Each stop shows which stores have it, and your sign-off sheet is the final word.

frames.narration: Fuel is two hours of new items, kiosk or walk-in, whichever your store has. One rule, and it comes from Fred Meyer: Compass does not carry product between the store and the fuel center, in either direction. Ask store management to get the new items out to the fuel center, and the fuel center handles the discontinued product and the backstock. On the kiosk window wrap-around racks, set them the way the customer sees them, left to right. Standing outside and facing the kiosk, lighters are always on the right. And if a data skin is broken or shopworn and a replacement is on hand, replace it. In this district it is kiosks everywhere except two eight one, which is a walk-in. Fuel is a priority set here, so it goes first thing. The fuel tags are wrapped separately in the box.
